question: Which state had fielded a 396-member contingent, the largest at Khelo India Youth Games 2021 and competed in every sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Haryana had the largest contingent at the 2021 Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG), sending 396 members to compete in every sport.
 
• The games were held in Panchkula, Haryana from June 4 to June 13, 2021.
 
• Haryana won the medal tally with 137 medals, while Maharashtra came in second with 125 medals. 
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games are India's largest grassroots-level sports competition.
 
• The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports launched the Khelo India Scheme to impr
ove India's sports culture and make it a sporting nation
